digest.component_or_area: bug tracker — blame and causality linkage
propositions: A one-time backfill script must retroactively draw `caused_by` links on existing closed bugs using the conservative single-culprit blame resolver.
The backfill script must be idempotent by checking for existing active `caused_by` edges via `_is_active_link` before writing, skipping bugs that already carry the link.
The script must operate in dry-run mode by default and require an explicit `--write` flag to persist links to the tracker.
Only high-confidence single-culprit resolutions are linked; ambiguous bugs (multiple potential culprits) are skipped.
The backfill reuses the same deterministic resolver as live auto-derivation to ensure consistency between retroactive and forward links.
